video.title: Duba yadda yake aiki
video.body: Taƙaitaccen bayani game da dandalin koyon Turanci mai komai a ciki — littattafai, matakai da ci gaba, duk a wuri ɗaya.
video.fallback: Burauzarka ba ta iya kunna bidiyon da aka saka ba. Maimakon haka, <link>kalli rangadin</link>.

hero.titleA: Littattafan da ke girma tare da ɗanka —
hero.titleB: daga sautukan farko zuwa karatu sosai.
hero.body: Littattafan fonetik 33 masu sauƙin furtawa a matakai 8. Duba matakin ɗanka kyauta, ku karanta tare a kowane allo, ko ka buga ƙananan littattafai na gaske da zai riƙe a hannu.
hero.freeNote: Littattafan farko a buɗe suke kuma kyauta yanzu — ba rajista, ba kati.

check.title: Duba matakinsa
check.desc: Gwajin sauti na minti 3 kyauta yana gano ainihin wurin farawa da ya dace. Ba zato, ba kati.

read.title: Karanta a kowane allo
read.desc: Littattafai masu mu'amala a waya, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta — taɓa kowace kalma don jin yadda ake furta ta sauti bayan sauti.

print.title: Ko ka buga ka riƙe
print.desc: Sauke kowane littafi a matsayin ƙaramin littafin A5 da ake ninkawa a ɗinke. Shafuka na gaske don karatun kafin barci.

testimonials.title: Abin da abokan cinikinmu ke cewa
testimonials.subtitle: Kalmomin gaske daga iyalai da malaman da ke amfani da MyPhonicsBooks.

journey.title: Daga sautukan farko zuwa sautukan ƙarshe
journey.subtitle: Matakai takwas, hanya ɗaya bayyananniya — kowane littafi yana amfani da sautukan da ɗanka ya koya kaɗai.

features.titleA: Duk abin da ɗanka ke buƙata don
features.body: Ƙwararrun fonetik ne suka gina shi, don yara na gaske. Kowane littafi yana amfani da sautukan da ɗanka ya koya kaɗai — don haka yana samun nasara tun daga shafin farko.
